module: "Rotate" modal operator (R key) of the Easy Select tool. Opens a transform session (history "EasySelectRotate") and rotates the selection around the pivot: without constraint the axis is the camera view direction, with an X/Y/Z constraint it is the chosen axis (world or local). The angle comes from the mouse-pivot screen angle or from a numeric input in degrees, with optional snapping. Left click/Enter confirms, right click/Esc cancels.
notes: Snapping is only applied to the mouse angle (not to numeric input) and if options.rotateSnapEnabled is true and rotateSnapSize > 0 (in degrees).
Changing axis or space resets the mouse reference and the angle to 0.

wantsBegin.desc: True if the R key has just been pressed.

begin.desc: Starts the rotation. Returns false if already active, session impossible or pivot not projectable.

update.desc: Every frame: handles end, constraint, input, computes the angle (rad), applies transformSession.updateRotation and draws the gizmo.

returns.desc: "active" during the operation, result of finish at the end, nil if inactive
true if an operator was active

setLocalSpace.desc: Toggles local/world space and resets the mouse reference.

returns.desc: false if the change did not happen

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the operator is in progress.

getObjectIds.desc: Ids of the session objects ({} if inactive).

drawScreen.desc: Draws the indicator and the HUD (VIEW/axis constraint, space, angle in degrees or typed text).
